mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (particularly potassium and magnesium), which may be exacerbated when combined with nafcillin; nafcillin may also contribute to renal dysfunction and hypokalemia through independent mechanisms.
action: Monitor renal function (BUN, creatinine), serum electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and urinalysis regularly; consider therapeutic drug monitoring and adjust dosing based on renal function; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation.
